environment: node v24, python3, scratch git repos from the cli-runner testkit

cases.title: Baseline: each mode samples only its own kinds
cases.given: A scratch git repo and branches.py preflight
cases.when: preflight runs in modes pr, stack, mr, direct
cases.then: kinds are checked per mode and stderr holds no traceback
cases.expected: Sampled kinds stay inside the allowed set for the mode. No sample has kind e2e-area, verify or attempt. No traceback.

cases.title: Hostile --branch values add no sampled kind
cases.given: A scratch git repo and branches.py preflight
cases.when: preflight runs in all 4 modes with each argv-safe entry of 7 corpus families as --branch
cases.then: kinds are checked per run and stderr holds no traceback
cases.expected: Sampled kinds stay inside the allowed set for the mode. No sample has kind e2e-area, verify or attempt. No traceback.

cases.title: Hostile --format values add no sampled kind and do not crash
cases.given: A scratch git repo and branches.py preflight
cases.when: preflight runs in all 4 modes with each corpus entry as --format
cases.then: kinds are checked and stderr holds no traceback and stderr holds no traceback
cases.expected: Sampled kinds stay inside the allowed set for the mode. No sample has kind e2e-area, verify or attempt. No traceback.

cases.title: Hostile branchFormat in config adds no sampled kind and does not crash
cases.given: A scratch git repo and branches.py preflight
cases.when: preflight runs in all 4 modes with each corpus entry as config branchFormat
cases.then: kinds are checked and stderr holds no traceback and stderr holds no traceback
cases.expected: Sampled kinds stay inside the allowed set for the mode. No sample has kind e2e-area, verify or attempt. No traceback.

attacks.charter: Explore --branch with flag-like, traversal, control-char, confusable, injection, format-string and whitespace values to find a sampled kind outside the mode table (R-137)
Explore --format with the same families to find a new sampled kind or a crash
Explore config branchFormat with the same families to find a new sampled kind or a crash

seeds.title: Hostile-input test cannot see a refusal that yields no samples
seeds.detail: When preflight refuses a hostile format, it prints no samples, so the kinds check holds for an empty set. The test proves no extra kind and no traceback, not the refusal text. Other lenses cover the refusal.
